Page Two

What Six Months Taught Us

Love ❤️

The kind that doesn't need a reason or an occasion — it just shows up, every ordinary day, in small ways you probably don't even notice I notice.

❤️ प्यार वो नहीं जिसे वजह चाहिए, प्यार तो बस हर दिन अपने छोटे-छोटे एहसासों से महसूस होता है। शायद तुम्हें पता भी नहीं चलता, लेकिन तुम्हारी हर छोटी बात मेरी दुनिया बन जाती है।

Talk 💬

The 1am conversations about nothing that turned into everything. You're still the person I want to tell things to first.

💕 रात की वो लंबी बातें आज भी मेरी सबसे खूबसूरत यादें हैं। हर खुशी, हर परेशानी... सबसे पहले तुम्हें ही बताने का मन करता है।

Care 🤍

The quiet kind — a message checking if I ate, remembering the small things, showing up on the hard days without being asked to.

🌸 तुम्हारी छोटी-छोटी परवाह मुझे हर दिन यह एहसास दिलाती है कि मैं सच में बहुत खुशनसीब हूँ। तुम्हारा साथ ही मेरी सबसे बड़ी ताकत है।

Tum Kya Ho Mere Liye ❤️
Page Three

What I Feel For You

a little note for you

Dhruvi, six months in and I still catch myself smiling at my phone when your name pops up. Thank you for the way you love — patiently, honestly, and fully. Thank you for staying through the disagreements and for laughing with me through everything else. Here's to talking more, caring louder, fighting fair, and loving harder — for every month after this one.

💕 ध्रुवी, इन छह महीनों के बाद भी जब भी मेरे फ़ोन पर तुम्हारा नाम आता है, मेरे चेहरे पर अपने आप मुस्कान आ जाती है। तुम्हारे धैर्य, सच्चाई और पूरे दिल से किए गए प्यार के लिए धन्यवाद। हर छोटी-बड़ी नोकझोंक में भी मेरा साथ निभाने और हर मुश्किल पल को अपनी हँसी से आसान बनाने के लिए शुक्रिया। आओ वादा करें कि आगे भी हम और खुलकर बातें करेंगे, एक-दूसरे की और ज़्यादा परवाह करेंगे, झगड़ेंगे भी तो प्यार से, और हर आने वाले महीने में अपने प्यार को और गहरा बनाएँगे। ❤️

— always yours
થોડાક શબ્દો, દિલથી

ફક્ત તારા માટે ❤️

તારી હાજરીમાં જ મારો દિવસ પૂરો લાગે છે.
"My day only feels complete when you're near."
તારા વગર ઘર પણ ખાલી ખાલી લાગે છે.
"Even home feels empty without you."
ઝઘડા ભલે થાય, પણ દિલ હંમેશા તારું જ રહેશે.
"We may fight, but my heart always stays yours."
તારો હાથ પકડીને જ સાચી શાંતિ મળે છે.
"Holding your hand is where I find real peace."
પ્રેમ એટલે રોજ નવેસરથી તને પસંદ કરવો.
"Love is choosing you all over again, every single day."
છ મહિના થયા, પણ લાગે છે જાણે કાલની જ વાત હોય.
"Six months gone by, yet it feels like just yesterday."

Our Memories

Dragon Garden · Where It Began

The first time we met, we barely talked — just a few words between us. But somehow, even in that silence, I already knew you were the one.

Gratitude

Thank you for coming into my life. Some people change everything just by being in it — you're that person for me.

A Simple Wish

I want you to always be happy — and I want to be right there beside you when you are.

Even The Fights

Yes, we fight sometimes — and that's okay. A little fighting is just part of real love. It means we care enough to be honest.

The Distance Between Us

We're miles apart right now, but that doesn't make the missing any smaller. I miss you every single day, truly.
